name: 319a-media-favorites
description: A media tile takes a media_player entity, an optional label and up to 6 favorites (#319); ids may hold colons and slashes.
input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    widgets:
      - {type: media, entity: media_player.living_room, cs: 2, favorites: Radio 1=music:http://icecast.omroep.nl/radio1-bb-mp3; Bedtime=script.good_night; Movie=scene.movie_night}
      - {type: media, entity: media_player.kitchen, label: Kitchen}
